cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Credit for the Discovery
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge that you found the clue, saw through the deception, or designed the successful scheme.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Before calling it our discovery, mention who found the receipt. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Yes. After my receipt introduced it properly.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll put your name in the report.

mechanism: A directs a complaint and grants shared checking credit while insisting the report attribute the decisive receipt discovery specifically to A.
confusable: Unlike wanting generic praise or a name at the top, A wants the found-the-clue role recognized; authority bargains over how others credit is included.
comparison: Written credit for proof of a double charge differs from a physical house-tour demonstration mistaken for mere door holding.
seedUse: D129-a receipt discovery and found-versus-attended credit made concrete as a double-charge complaint; S02-a accommodates shared effort while controlling attribution.
